state.background: Review only the P42-459 migration plan. Exact E2E case tests/e2e/range-change.e2e.spec.ts A1 at lines 119-137 raises the real page's start year through setRange while preserving end year. Its post-change metric is contractPeriodCount(page, NOMINAL), which counts data-chart-data-row entries emitted by ChartDataContract from the nominal chart data, and asserts the new count is less than the initial count. Proposed component-independent unit destination: a new renderHook test for useCpiChartDisplayData in tests/unit/useCpiChartDisplayData.test.ts. Use QuarterlyView rows 2005Q1-Q4 and 2006Q1-Q4 with hiddenQuarters=[] and endYear=2006; startYear=2005 should yield 8 filteredQuarterlyNominalData rows, while startYear=2006 yields exactly four 2006Q1-Q4 rows. Existing computeChartData unit tests do not test this year-range filtering and no dedicated hook test exists; useUrlState.test.ts establishes renderHook precedent. Data flow is CpiChart -> useCpiChartDisplayData.filteredQuarterlyNominalData (inclusive year bounds plus hidden-quarter filtering) -> normalizeSpendingChartData (mapping only) -> SpendingBarChart -> ChartDataContract (one row per chartData entry). Proposed E2E replacement is only the post-range-change period-count reduction assertion with visible first nominal SVG bar; preserve real route range selection and chart redraw evidence. Component/hook unit test does not prove route-to-chart wiring. P42-460..462 stay untouched. Main plan, callsite ledger and responsibility matrix record this scope and mark JEV pending; no implementation/test exists yet.
